verdict.rationale: A UI framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship AI-assisted devtools, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions Vue devtools, let alone AI analysis of the component tree or optimization suggestions. The compiler-optimized rendering claim and the llms.txt documentation are adjacent features, not AI-powered devtools.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI-powered devtools that analyze my component tree and suggest specific rendering or reactivity optimizations
